expectations.evidence: Most of the 12 hooks lift the review vocabulary almost verbatim: C1 H2 "I hadn't opened my bank app in four days" and H3 "I was genuinely scared of my own money" (on-screen: "4 days avoiding my bank app", "scared of my own money") come straight from "I stopped being scared to open my bank app"; C2 H3 "my chaos-fixer app" and H1 "three payments, three random days" track "it made my chaos months make sense"; all three C3 hooks and C4 H2 use "spiky income" explicitly, and C4 H1/H3 ("Fixed-paycheck budgets are", "built for one paycheck?") are the same irregular-income wedge.
